findings.label: verifyEmail tokenHash select gap
findings.description: Both verifyEmail and resetPassword use .where('tokenHash').equals() after .select('+tokenHash'). In Mongoose 7+, the select projection controls what is returned, not what is matched; the tokenHash condition may be silently ignored, causing findOne to return the first matching token of that type regardless of hash value. Fix: pass tokenHash directly into findOne({ tokenHash, type: 'email_verification' }).select('+tokenHash').

findings.label: Expired session not revoked before throw
findings.description: In refreshTokens, when session.expiresAt <= now, the code throws without setting revokedAt. A second call with the same expired token hits the expiry branch again instead of the reuse-detection branch, bypassing the high-severity audit. Revoke the session (set revokedAt + revokeReason='expired', await session.save()) before throwing.

findings.label: authenticate cookie fallback contradicts spec
findings.description: authenticate.js falls back to req.cookies.accessToken when no Authorization header is present. The spec requires access tokens in the response body only, never in cookies. Remove this fallback.

findings.label: Missing standalone verifyEmail test
findings.description: auth.test.js has no test that retrieves the verification token from getSentEmails() and calls GET /api/v1/auth/verify-email?token=... The registerAndVerify helper bypasses the token flow by directly setting isEmailVerified=true in the DB, meaning bugs in verifyEmail would not be caught. Add a dedicated test for the token-based verification path.

findings.label: Missing logout session invalidation and changePassword tests
findings.description: The logout test confirms HTTP 200 but does not verify the session is revoked (a subsequent /refresh should return 401). There is no test for POST /api/v1/auth/change-password at all, including the session-revocation requirement. Both are required by the spec.

findings.label: forgotPassword silently blocks unverified accounts with no recovery path
findings.description: Users who registered but never verified their email are silently excluded from the password reset flow (isEmailVerified guard), and no resend-verification endpoint exists. Add a resend-verification endpoint or decouple the reset guard from email verification status.
